license_required.quote: No person may practice or represent himself or herself as practicing medicine without first having a valid license to do so.

issuing_authority.quote: The Washington medical commission as established in chapter 18.71 RCW governing licenses and registrations issued under chapters 18.71, 18.71A, 18.71B, 18.71C, and 18.71D RCW

type.quote: The Washington medical commission as established in chapter 18.71 RCW governing licenses and registrations issued under chapters 18.71, 18.71A, 18.71B, 18.71C, and 18.71D RCW

moral_character_required.quote: That the applicant is of good moral character

degree_required.value: Graduation from a school of medicine approved by the commission
degree_required.quote: That the applicant has attended and graduated from a school of medicine approved by the commission

accrediting_body.quote: The commission may approve any school of medicine which is located in any state, territory, or possession of the United States, the District of Columbia, or in the Dominion of Canada

required.quote: That the applicant has completed two years of postgraduate medical training in a program acceptable to the commission

duration.quote: completed two years of postgraduate medical training in a program acceptable to the commission

kind.quote: two years of postgraduate medical training in a program acceptable to the commission

exams.name: Commission examination
exams.notes: Commission prepares and gives, or approves preparation and giving of, an examination covering general subjects required of candidates for the degree of doctor of medicine
exams.quote: applicants for licensure must successfully complete an examination administered by the commission to determine their professional qualifications

exams.name: National Board of Medical Examiners examination
exams.notes: Passing NBME examination may qualify applicant for license without examination
exams.quote: an applicant who has satisfactorily passed examinations given by the national board of medical examiners may, in the discretion of the commission, be granted a license without examination

exams.name: Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG) examination
exams.notes: Required for foreign graduates in lieu of domestic school approval
exams.jurisdiction: national (Educational Council for Foreign Medical Graduates)
exams.quote: That he or she has satisfactorily passed the examination given by the educational council for foreign medical graduates or has met the requirements in lieu thereof as set forth in rules adopted by the commission

exams.name: United States Medical Licensing Examination (USMLE)
exams.notes: Required for interstate compact expedited licensure eligibility
exams.quote: Passed each component of the United States medical licensing examination (USMLE) or the comprehensive osteopathic medical licensing examination (COMLEX-USA) within three attempts

required.quote: The commission may establish rules governing mandatory continuing education requirements which shall be met by physicians applying for renewal of licenses.

hours_per_period.quote: The number of hours of continuing education for a physician holding a retired active license shall not exceed fifty hours per year.

period_years.quote: The number of hours of continuing education for a physician holding a retired active license shall not exceed fifty hours per year.

topical_requirements.quote: mandatory continuing education requirements may be met in part by physicians showing evidence of the completion of approved activities relating to professional liability risk management

available.quote: Any applicant who meets the requirements of RCW 18.71.050 and has been licensed under the laws of another state, territory, or possession of the United States, or of any province of Canada... may, in the discretion of the commission, be granted a license without examination

requirements.value: Applicant must meet all requirements of RCW 18.71.050, file a certified copy of their license, and show that the other state's standards and examinations are at least equal to Washington's.
requirements.quote: the applicant must file with the commission a copy of the license certified by the proper authorities of the issuing state to be a full, true copy thereof, and must show that the standards, eligibility requirements, and examinations of that state are at least equal in all respects to those of this state

national_certification.quote: "Maintenance of certification" means the satisfactory participation in a formal recertification program to maintain board certification after initial certification from the American board of medical specialties or other accrediting organization recognized by the commission.

regulatory_model.quote: No person may practice or represent himself or herself as practicing medicine without first having a valid license to do so.

credential_type.quote: Licensure, which is the most restrictive and requires qualification by examination and educational prerequisites of a practitioner whose title is protected and whose scope of practice is restricted to only those licensed.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may practice or represent himself or herself as practicing medicine without first having a valid license to do so.

title_protection.quote: Uses on cards, books, papers, signs, or other written or printed means of giving information to the public, in the conduct of any occupation or profession pertaining to the diagnosis or treatment of human disease or conditions the designation "doctor of medicine," "physician," "surgeon," "m.d.," or any combination thereof

scope_protection.quote: No person may practice or represent himself or herself as practicing medicine without first having a valid license to do so.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The commission of any act involving moral turpitude, dishonesty, or corruption relating to the practice of the person's profession, whether the act constitutes a crime or not.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining or reinstating a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or concealment of a material fact in obtaining a license or in reinstatement thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: All advertising which is false, fraudulent, or misleading
disciplinary_grounds.quote: All advertising which is false, fraudulent, or misleading

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice resulting in injury to a patient or unreasonable risk of harm
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetence, negligence, or malpractice which results in injury to a patient or which creates an unreasonable risk that a patient may be harmed.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of the individual's license in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Suspension, revocation, or restriction of the individual's license to practice any health care profession by competent authority in any state, federal, or foreign jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Possession, use, prescription, or distribution of controlled substances or legend drugs other than for legitimate therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The possession, use, prescription for use, or distribution of controlled substances or legend drugs in any way other than for legitimate or therapeutic purposes, diversion of controlled substances or legend drugs, the violation of any drug law, or prescribing controlled substances for oneself

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any state or federal statute or administrative rule regulating the profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any state or federal statute or administrative rule regulating the profession in question, including any statute or rule defining or establishing standards of patient care or professional conduct or practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with the disciplining authority in investigations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate with the disciplining authority by: (a) Not furnishing any papers, documents, records, or other items

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplining authority or a stipulation for informal disposition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with an order issued by the disciplining authority or a stipulation for informal disposition entered into with the disciplining authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice when a license is required
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to practice when a license is required

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practice beyond the scope of practice as defined by law or rule
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice beyond the scope of practice as defined by law or rule

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresentation or fraud in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresentation or fraud in any aspect of the conduct of the business or profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately supervise auxiliary staff to the extent that consumer health or safety is at risk
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to adequately supervise auxiliary staff to the extent that the consumer's health or safety is at risk

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in a profession involving contact with the public while suffering from a contagious or infectious disease involving serious risk to public health
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in a profession involving contact with the public while suffering from a contagious or infectious disease involving serious risk to public health

disciplinary_grounds.description: Promotion for personal gain of any unnecessary or inefficacious drug, device, treatment, procedure, or service
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Promotion for personal gain of any unnecessary or inefficacious drug, device, treatment, procedure, or service

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the person's profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of any gross misdemeanor or felony relating to the practice of the person's profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering or agreeing to treat disease by a secret method, procedure, or medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The offering, undertaking, or agreeing to cure or treat disease by a secret method, procedure, treatment, or medicine, or the treating, operating, or prescribing for any health condition by a method, means, or procedure which the licensee refuses to divulge upon demand of the disciplining authority

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful betrayal of a practitioner-patient privilege as recognized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The willful betrayal of a practitioner-patient privilege as recognized by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation, threats, or financial inducements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Interference with an investigation or disciplinary proceeding by willful misrepresentation of facts before the disciplining authority or its authorized representative, or by the use of threats or harassment against any patient or witness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Current misuse of alcohol, controlled substances, or legend drugs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Current misuse of: (a) Alcohol; (b) Controlled substances; or (c) Legend drugs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abuse of a client or patient or sexual contact with a client or patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abuse of a client or patient or sexual contact with a client or patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing conversion therapy on a patient under age eighteen
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing conversion therapy on a patient under age eighteen

disciplinary_grounds.description: Implanting the license holder's own gametes or reproductive material into a patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Implanting the license holder's own gametes or reproductive material into a patient.

definition_quote.value: A person is practicing medicine if he or she does one or more of the following: (1) Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality; (2) Administers or prescribes drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person; (3) Severs or penetrates the tissues of human beings
definition_quote.quote: A person is practicing medicine if he or she does one or more of the following: (1) Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality

value: advising on human disease or conditions
methods_authorized.quote: Offers or undertakes to diagnose, cure, advise, or prescribe for any human disease, ailment, injury, infirmity, deformity, pain or other condition, physical or mental, real or imaginary, by any means or instrumentality; (2) Administers or prescribes drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person; (3) Severs or penetrates the tissues of human beings

drug_authority.value: Physicians may administer or prescribe drugs or medicinal preparations; may prescribe controlled substances; subject to opioid prescribing rules adopted by the commission
drug_authority.quote: Administers or prescribes drugs or medicinal preparations to be used by any other person

license_status_types.quote: An individual licensed pursuant to chapter 18.71 RCW may place his or her license on inactive status.

foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.value: Foreign graduates must complete a resident course of professional instruction equivalent to that required generally; must pass ECFMG examination or meet requirements in lieu thereof adopted by the commission; must be able to read, write, speak, understand, and be understood in English; and meet all other requirements of domestic graduates except graduation from a commission-approved school.
foreign_medical_graduate_requirements.quote: That he or she has satisfactorily passed the examination given by the educational council for foreign medical graduates or has met the requirements in lieu thereof as set forth in rules adopted by the commission

postgraduate_training_years_required.quote: That the applicant has completed two years of postgraduate medical training in a program acceptable to the commission

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: Commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs, including possible exemptions based on education, training, amount of opioids prescribed, patient panel, and practice environment. Rules must address dosing criteria including a dosage amount that must not be exceeded without consultation with a pain management specialist. Rules must require informing patients of their right to refuse an opioid prescription.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: By January 1, 2019, the commission must adopt rules establishing requirements for prescribing opioid drugs. The rules may contain exemptions based on education, training, amount of opioids prescribed, patient panel, and practice environment.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: Statute does not prohibit out-of-state practitioners from consulting through telemedicine with Washington-licensed practitioners who retain responsibility for diagnosis and treatment.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: The consultation through telemedicine or other means by a practitioner, licensed by another state or territory in which he or she resides, with a practitioner licensed in this state who has responsibility for the diagnosis and treatment of the patient within this state

interstate_medical_licensure_compact_mem.quote: the member states of the interstate medical licensure compact have allied in common purpose to develop a comprehensive process that complements the existing licensing and regulatory authority of state medical boards, provides a streamlined process that allows physicians to become licensed in multiple states

physician_assistant_supervision_model.quote: The practice of medicine by a licensed physician assistant which practice is performed under the supervision of or in collaboration with a physician licensed pursuant to this chapter

malpractice_reporting_required.quote: Every institution or organization providing professional liability insurance to physicians shall send a complete report to the commission of all malpractice settlements, awards, or payments in excess of twenty thousand dollars

hospital_privilege_action_reporting_requ.quote: Every license holder, corporation, organization, health care facility, and state and local governmental agency that employs a license holder shall report to the disciplining authority when the employed license holder's services have been terminated or restricted

impaired_physician_program_authorized.quote: The commission shall enter into a contract with the entity to implement a physician health program.

compelled_mental_physical_exam_authority.quote: the disciplining authority may require a license holder to submit to a mental or physical examination by one or more licensed or certified health professionals designated by the disciplining authority
